title: payment-api checkout timeouts, mixed 502/503
summary: Same underlying failure as INC-A1 (Redis connection-pool exhaustion) with deliberately different wording, a different release, different timing and a distracting dependency. With Hindsight memory the agent recognises the pattern in one analysis pass, refuses to repeat the failed pod restart and goes straight to the per-worker connection diagnostic.
symptom: Checkout latency crossed the 4s timeout and responses are a mix of 502 and 503. Cache acquisition timed out is the dominant log signature.
demo_notes: This is the incident that proves Hindsight matters. Nothing here says 'leak' until stage three - the recall of INC-A1 is what moves redis_pool_exhaustion to the top immediately.
